declarations.description: Fullscreen controls for video, embedded content, or an authored wrapper.
declarations.name: FullscreenControlElement

members.name: buttonText
members.description: The visible text displayed inside the fullscreen button.

members.name: buttonLabel
members.description: Optional aria-label text for the fullscreen button. Falls back to the visible button text when empty.

members.name: target
members.description: Fullscreen the first nested video/iframe, or the host and all its contents. Changes during pending entry or fullscreen apply after entry fails or fullscreen exits.

members.name: exitText
members.description: Visible exit text in self mode. Supports {name}.

members.name: exitLabel
members.description: Optional exit button aria-label in self mode. Supports {name}.

members.name: errorText
members.description: Visible plain-text failure message in the self-mode status region.
members.default: 'Unable to change fullscreen. Try again or use the browser controls.'

members.name: enterFullscreen
members.description: Requests fullscreen for the first nested video/iframe by default, or the host with target=self. Usually requires a user gesture. Failures are logged and shown in a localized status region in self mode; the promise does not report success.

members.name: toggleFullscreen
members.description: Toggles fullscreen mode on or off.

events.name: fullscreen-control:enter
events.description: Fired on an observed transition into fullscreen for the selected target. Bubbles and is composed; detail is null.

events.name: fullscreen-control:exit
events.description: Fired on an observed transition out of fullscreen for the selected target. Bubbles and is composed; detail is null.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: media (default, including missing/empty) targets the first video/iframe; self targets the host and its controls without modifying descendants. Unknown values warn and do not enhance. Changes during pending entry or fullscreen apply after entry fails or fullscreen exits.

attributes.name: exit-text
attributes.description: Visible button text while the host is fullscreen in self mode. Supports the same {name} replacement as button-text, using the host name.

attributes.name: exit-label
attributes.description: Optional exit aria-label in self mode. Supports {name}. Empty or identical resolved labels omit aria-label.

attributes.name: error-text
attributes.description: Visible plain-text message in a generated role=status region after self-mode entry or exit fails, including unavailable APIs. Cleared on the next attempt.
attributes.default: 'Unable to change fullscreen. Try again or use the browser controls.'

attributes.name: button-text
attributes.description: Visible button text. Each {name} token uses the target's first nonempty aria-label or title, or an empty string. Names use String.replace replacement string semantics, including special $ sequences; resolved output is inserted as text, not HTML. Missing or empty text uses the default.

attributes.name: button-label
attributes.description: Optional button aria-label with the same {name} substitution as button-text. Empty or identical resolved labels omit aria-label so visible text names the button. Include the visible wording in a distinct label.

cssProperties.name: --fullscreen-control-button-inset-block-start
cssProperties.description: Block-start (top) position of the fullscreen button.

cssProperties.name: --fullscreen-control-button-inset-inline-end
cssProperties.description: Inline-end (right in LTR) position of the fullscreen button.

modules.description: Class-only package entry; does not register a custom element.

declarations.name: defineFullscreenControl
declarations.description: Importing this module registers the default tag when a browser registry is available. The helper returns false without a usable registry and true when the requested tag is already defined. Calling it for another unregistered tag throws NotSupportedError because the constructor is already registered. For a custom tag, use the class-only import from fullscreen-control.js and register once without importing this module.
